title: Pin Art
description: A flat bed of steel pins on a black plate with a face pressed through from behind: Christy Mathewson and Cy Young from their 1909 baseball cards, and the half-lit portrait of With the Beatles. Left alone, the bed presses the next picture through on its own in one slow travelling wave; drag to push your fingertip in, and the pins rise with weight, hold a moment, then settle back into the picture.
intent: Pin art drawn as flat graphic design rather than a 3D render: each pin is a two-tone disc whose size and brightness are its height, every pin is a damped spring, and the default loop is a wave that rolls one portrait into the next.
sources: Baseball cards: Christy Mathewson and Cy Young, 1909, public domain scans via Wikimedia Commons (Library of Congress), public/flyout/card-03.jpg and card-04.jpg
